title: Deep Space Seed Twin: a cellular digital twin of Arabidopsis germination under spaceflight hardware environments
description: In-browser 3D cellular model of an Arabidopsis seed from imbibition to a 5-day seedling, with water uptake, O2/CO2/ethylene exchange, an ABA-GA-Integrator hormone network, Lockhart growth under seed-coat restraint and seedling kinematics, run under spaceflight hardware presets. Companion to deepspace-seed-stress-decoder. Every parameter is listed with its source and evidence tier in data/params/parameter_ledger.csv.
